WITH account_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    COUNT(*) as account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
total_accounts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM account
),
num_districts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as num_districts FROM account_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.district_id,
    ac.account_count,
    CAST(ac.account_count AS REAL) / ta.total as share
  FROM account_counts ac, total_accounts ta
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT 1.0 / nd.num_districts as avg FROM num_districts nd
),
with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    s.district_id,
    s.account_count,
    s.share,
    s.share - a.avg as diff_from_avg
  FROM shares s, avg_share a
)
SELECT 
  district_id,
  account_count,
  share,
  diff_from_avg
FROM with_diff
ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "Average share across districts" means the arithmetic mean of all districts' shares, calculated as 1 / (count of districts with accounts). Since all shares sum to 1, this equals 1/D where D is the number of districts represented in the account table.

"Dropping any other districts tied with the 10th" means we do not extend the result set beyond 10 rows to include ties at the boundary—a clarification for LIMIT 10, not a request to drop ties within the top 10.
